items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; HC says no plans to place on IR.
items.why: Glute injury; confirmed OUT with no IR plans.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; impacts SEA pass-catcher volume and matchup.
items.opportunity: Drew Lock or equivalent elevated; SEA skill players face lower floor.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) will not practice Wednesday; ETR lists Tre’ Harris as primary waiver beneficiary. Harbaugh day-to-day earlier.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; no Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Questionable for Week 2; monitor Friday report. Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris upside if out.
items.opportunity: Tre’ Harris primary beneficiary for snaps/routes/targets.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery to quicken recovery; IR designation.
items.implication: Out minimum 4 games; opens WR snaps/targets in BAL.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman and Chris Moore elevated per ETR.

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain expected 4-6 weeks; ETR waiver beneficiaries Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; multi-week absence.
items.implication: NE WR targets open; Drake Maye pass-catchers elevated short-term.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted in Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Monitor for further limitations; potential reduced snap/route share if worsens.
items.opportunity: Possible target/route opportunity for other HOU WRs if limited further.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice participant after ankle issue.
items.implication: Likely available Week 2; monitor for snap share behind Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Potential change-of-pace/flex role; reverse any stale handcuff beneficiaries.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor practice progression; potential limited role or inactive risk.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated if misses time.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness; DNP but expects to play.
items.implication: Likely active; CIN pass-catchers (Chase, Higgins, Brown) retain high floors if he plays.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week on FFHappyHour amid Stribling injury fallout.
items.why: Stribling (ankle surgery, ~10 weeks) opens SF WR role; Deebo elevated.
items.implication: Priority add for immediate WR2/flex upside in WAS? Wait SF context per ETR.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets with Stribling out long-term.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year. Scary.
items.why: Coach comments on working to rejoin; possible early return but knee history concern.
items.implication: Potential TE1 if returns healthy Week 2/3; stash priority. History raises re-injury risk.
items.opportunity: If out longer, LV TE/WR beneficiaries.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 Week 1); only 2 targets 7% share despite 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd to Worthy). Needs serious volume to pay off.
items.why: High routes but low targets/aDOT in blowout; Walker addition neutering volume.
items.implication: Volume-dependent; fade or monitor for trailing/zone scripts. ROS adjustment likely.
items.opportunity: Routes present but target share suppressed; Walker opps impact.
items.conflict: High route participation vs low production.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. He fucks.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and routes/targets as expected post-Seattle departure.
items.implication: Elite RB1 weekly floor/ceiling if sustained; clear workhorse.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/route/target share confirmed; goal-line and receiving upside.

items.text: First ROS Top-150 rankings live: discussing CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty and more with opportunity adjustments post-Week 1.
items.why: Post-Week 1 usage/injury adjustments in live ROS show with Levitan et al.
items.implication: Trade value and hold/sell signals based on early opportunity data.
items.opportunity: Opportunity-first rankings; Etienne/Kamara situation, Rice volume concerns noted.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after surgery for torn MCL; IR.
items.implication: Season over; SF TE depth thinned (Kittle primary).
items.opportunity: Possible streaming TE or Hodge/Stoll elevation but low fantasy impact.
